assessment: This interesting study presents important information on how human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) infection disrupts the activity of the TEAD1 transcription factor, leading to widespread chromatin alterations. The strength of evidence in revised manuscript is convincing, and includes additional functional data teasing out how TEAD1-driven chromatin changes might influence HCMV replication. This work will be of interest to the virology, chromosome biology and transcriptional co-regulation fields.
